parameters.query:
SELECT d.candidate_id, d.subject AS orig_subject, d.body AS orig_body, d.followup_count,
       EXTRACT(day FROM now() - COALESCE(d.last_followup_at, d.sent_at))::int AS days_since,
       c.business_name, c.email, c.address, c.suburb, c.qualification_score,
       s.code AS segment_code
FROM leads.outreach_drafts d
JOIN leads.candidates c ON c.id = d.candidate_id
JOIN leads.crm_records r ON r.candidate_id = d.candidate_id
LEFT JOIN leads.segments s ON s.id = c.segment_id
WHERE d.status = 'sent'
  AND d.followup_count < 3
  AND r.stage = 'contacted'
  AND r.status = 'active'
  AND c.email IS NOT NULL
  AND c.duplicate_of IS NULL
  AND c.do_not_contact = false
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM leads.inbound_replies ir
                  WHERE ir.candidate_id = d.candidate_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM leads.suppression sp
                  WHERE sp.email_norm = leads.norm_email(c.email)
                    AND sp.reason IN ('hard_bounce','opt_out','cleaning_competitor'))
  AND (CASE d.followup_count
         WHEN 0 THEN d.sent_at + interval '3 days'
         WHEN 1 THEN d.last_followup_at + interval '7 days'
         WHEN 2 THEN d.last_followup_at + interval '14 days'
       END) <= now()
ORDER BY c.qualification_score DESC NULLS LAST, d.sent_at
LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) AS total_followups_sent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at::date = now()::date) AS sent_today FROM leads.outreach_followups

WITH log AS (
  INSERT INTO leads.outreach_followups (candidate_id, followup_no, subject, body, sent_to, message_id)
  VALUES ($1::bigint, $2::smallint, $3, $4, $5, $6)
  ON CONFLICT (candidate_id, followup_no) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING candidate_id
),
d AS (
  UPDATE leads.outreach_drafts
  SET followup_count = $2::smallint, last_followup_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE candidate_id = (SELECT candidate_id FROM log)
  RETURNING candidate_id
)
UPDATE leads.crm_records
SET last_contact_at = now(), updated_at = now()
WHERE candidate_id = (SELECT candidate_id FROM d);

parameters.content:
## Outreach Follow-up Engine v1.1 (AI Gateway)

Weekdays Tue-Fri 09:30 Adelaide: sends up to 25 personalized follow-ups per run to leads whose first email was sent but who have not progressed past stage=contacted in the CRM.

Cadence: FU1 at day 2, FU2 at day 5 (3 days after FU1), FU3 (final, breakup note) at day 10 (5 days after FU2). Max 3 follow-ups per lead. Auto-stops on any CRM stage/status change.

The stage is claimed atomically in Fetch Due Follow-ups (followup_count is incremented in the same locked UPDATE that selects the lead), so overlapping or re-fired runs can never send the same follow-up twice.

v1.1: follow-up wording is generated by the AI Gateway (generate_followup_v2 / Qwen 3 8B) via POST /v1/ai/outreach/followup, with the original deterministic template retained as an automatic fallback if the AI call fails — a send NEVER fails because of AI. Subject keeps deterministic 'Re:' threading. Cadence, caps, stop rules, sending and audit logging are unchanged and deterministic.
